pairs: Hæ sunt gentes quas Dominus dereliquit,
These are the nations which the Lord left,
so that by them he might instruct Israel
et omnes qui non noverant bella Chananæorum:
and all who had not known the wars of the Canaanites,
ut postea discerent filii eorum certare cum hostibus,
so that afterward their sons might learn to contend with their enemies,
and to have a willingness to do battle:
the five princes of the Philistines,
atque Hevæum, qui habitabat in monte Libano,
and the Hivites who were living on Mount Lebanon,
de monte Baal Hermon usque ad introitum Emath.
from Mount Baal-Hermon as far as the entrance to Hamath.
so that by them he might test Israel,
utrum audiret mandata Domini quæ præceperat patribus eorum per manum Moysi,
as to whether or not they would listen to the commandments of the Lord,
which he instructed to their fathers by the hand of Moses.
Itaque filii Israël habitaverunt in medio Chananæi,
And so, the sons of Israel lived in the midst of the Canaanite,
And they took their daughters as wives,
ipsique filias suas filiis eorum tradiderunt,
and they gave their own daughters to their sons,
And they did evil in the sight of the Lord,
while serving the Baals and Ashtaroth.
And the Lord, having become angry with Israel,
tradidit eos in manus Chusan Rasathaim regis Mesopotamiæ,
delivered them into the hands of Cushan-Rishathaim, the king of Mesopotamia,
and they served him for eight years.
And they cried out to the Lord,
who raised up for them a savior,
namely, Othniel, the son of Kenaz,
And the Spirit of the Lord was in him,
And he went out to fight,
et tradidit Dominus in manus ejus Chusan Rasathaim regem Syriæ,
and the Lord delivered Cushan-Rishathaim, the king of Syria,
And the land was quiet for forty years.
et mortuus est Othoniel filius Cenez.
And Othniel, the son of Kenaz, died.
Addiderunt autem filii Israël facere malum in conspectu Domini:
Then the sons of Israel resumed doing evil in the sight of the Lord,
qui confortavit adversum eos Eglon regem Moab,
who strengthened Eglon, the king of Moab,
quia fecerunt malum in conspectu ejus.
against them because they did evil in his sight.
Et copulavit ei filios Ammon, et Amalec:
And he joined to him the sons of Ammon and the sons of Amalek.
And he went forth and struck Israel,
and he possessed the City of Palms.
Servieruntque filii Israël Eglon regi Moab decem et octo annis.
And the sons of Israel served Eglon, the king of Moab, for eighteen years.
And afterward, they cried out to the Lord,
qui suscitavit eis salvatorem vocabulo Aod,
who raised up for them a savior, called Ehud,
qui utraque manu pro dextera utebatur.
who used either hand as well as the right hand.
Miseruntque filii Israël per illum munera Eglon regi Moab.
And the sons of Israel sent gifts to Eglon, the king of Moab, by him.
And he made for himself a two-edged sword,
habentem in medio capulum longitudinis palmæ manus,
having a handle, reaching to the middle, the length of the palm of a hand.
et accinctus est eo subter sagum in dextro femore.
And he was girded with it under his cloak, on the right thigh.
And he offered the gifts to Eglon,
the king of Moab. Now Eglon was exceedingly fat.
And when he had presented the gifts to him,
returning from Gilgal where the idols were,
“I have a secret word for you,
egressisque omnibus qui circa eum erant,
And when all those who were around him had departed,
sedebat autem in æstivo cœnaculo solus:
Now he was sitting alone in a summer upper room.
“I have a word from God to you.”
And immediately he rose up from his throne.
And Ehud extended his left hand,
et tulit sicam de dextro femore suo,
and he took the dagger from his right thigh.
And he thrust it into his abdomen
tam valide, ut capulus sequeretur ferrum in vulnere,
so strongly that the handle followed the blade into the wound,
and was enclosed by the great amount of fat.
Neither did he withdraw the sword.
sed ita ut percusserat, reliquit in corpore:
Instead, he left it in the body just as he had struck with it.
statimque per secreta naturæ alvi stercora proruperunt.
And immediately, by the private parts of nature, the filth of the bowels went out.
Aod autem clausis diligentissime ostiis cœnaculi,
Then Ehud carefully closed the doors of the upper room.
he departed by a back exit.
Servique regis ingressi viderunt clausas fores cœnaculi,
And the servants of the king, entering, saw that the doors of the upper room were closed,
Forsitan purgat alvum in æstivo cubiculo.
“Perhaps he is emptying his bowels in the summer room.”
And after waiting a long time, until they were embarrassed,
and seeing that no one opened the door,
et aperientes invenerunt dominum suum in terra jacentem mortuum.
and opening it, they found their lord lying dead on the ground.
and passed by the place of the idols,
et statim insonuit buccina in monte Ephraim,
And immediately he sounded the trumpet on Mount Ephraim.
And the sons of Israel descended with him,
he himself advancing at the front.
tradidit enim Dominus inimicos nostros Moabitas in manus nostras.
For the Lord has delivered our enemies, the Moabites, into our hands.”
et occupaverunt vada Jordanis quæ transmittunt in Moab:
and they occupied the fords of the Jordan, which cross over to Moab.
And they did not permit anyone to cross.
sed percusserunt Moabitas in tempore illo,
they struck down the Moabites at that time,
None of them were able to escape.
Humiliatusque est Moab in die illo sub manu Israël:
And Moab was humbled in that day under the hand of Israel.
And the land was quiet for eighty years.
Post hunc fuit Samgar filius Anath,
After him, there was Shamgar, the son of Anath,
qui percussit de Philisthiim sexcentos viros vomere:
who struck down six hundred men of the Philistines with a plowshare.
